config.retain_mission: Extract durable operational memory from scheduled personal-assistant agents: task definitions, schedules, preferences for triage/summaries, recurring external signals, standing filters, notable changes, decisions made by automation, unresolved follow-ups, and summary outputs that the main user-facing agent may need. Ignore raw email/social/feed content unless it changes a standing pattern, creates a follow-up, or is explicitly important. Do not store sensitive raw message bodies when a concise fact is enough.
config.observations_mission: Synthesize durable assistant-ops patterns: recurring triage outcomes, sources that matter, standing rules, schedule effectiveness, follow-up patterns, preference changes, and contradictions between what automations did and what the user later wanted. Focus on improving future scheduled tasks and informing the main agent's user-facing summaries. Ignore one-off notifications and ephemeral inbox noise.
config.reflect_mission: You are the memory perspective for scheduled personal-assistant agents whose outputs are communicated only through the main user-facing agent. Use memories to summarize what changed, what needs attention, which standing rules apply, and what follow-ups remain. Be privacy-conscious, concise, and explicit about uncertainty.
